## Context

Executable repair for Goal #62, derived from failed deployment v0.2.0 under Goal #59. Change only the release metadata required by the existing workflow, verify the full suite, merge, publish, install and validate.

## Expected outcome

A verified v0.2.1 release replaces the failed v0.2.0 attempt without altering historical tags.

## Scope

- elixir/mix.exs version
- Complete QA
- PR and main integration
- Burrito GitHub release
- X1 installation and runtime verification

## Out of scope

- Retagging v0.2.0
- Feature changes

## Acceptance criteria

- Version/tag match
- Full QA green
- PR merged to main
- Release assets and checksums available
- Exact artifact verified on X1
